verdict.rationale: Productboard's own integrations directory says it can 'Import sales & support conversations' and 'Import messages containing ideas & feedback', and lists Zendesk and Microsoft Teams integrations. It also claims to automatically detect insights within feedback. However, the evidence is a set of short marketing lines with no detail on which call or chat tools are supported or how automatic the capture is. Missing for 10: named sales-call recording integrations, documented automatic (not manual) ingestion from tickets and chats, depth on how insights are extracted from conversations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically capture customer feedback mentioned in sales calls, support tickets, and chat conversations

citations.quote: Import sales & support conversations. Uncover valuable user insights.
